name: Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca
positioning: Oceanfront Four Seasons hotel on Casablanca's Corniche, opened in November 2015
best_for: Travelers who want an oceanfront base minutes from the Hassan II Mosque
Couples who want a spa with couples suites and balneo pools

facts.text: The hotel has 184 rooms in total.
The hotel is located on the city's vibrant Corniche, nestled between the Atlantic Ocean and the affluent Anfa residential neighbourhood.
The hotel was designed by architects Foster + Partners.
Interiors are modern with design elements inspired by traditional Moroccan motifs.
The hotel cascades down a hillside toward the ocean.
Bleu serves a refined breakfast with cold buffet selections and à la carte dishes.
Mint is the hotel's lobby lounge, modelled after a traditional Moroccan salon.
Kyúb is a seasonal coastal restaurant offering al fresco dining.

highlights.text: The Grand Premier Ocean-View Room has a private balcony with unobstructed views of the Atlantic.
Le Spa has 10 treatment rooms, including 2 couples suites.
The spa has two balneo-hydrotherapy pools.
The outdoor pool is heated year-round.
The hotel is oceanfront, just minutes away from the landmark Hassan II Mosque.

considerations.text: The hotel does not possess a liquor license.
Kyúb offers al fresco dining from April to September.
Mohammed V International Airport is 45 minutes by car from the hotel.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
